execution: Independent writer process; public engine writes only; fresh open/write/await-close per operation. Retained control reuses the writer, otherwise identical sequence. No keeper, backlog, retries, extraction or model calls.

perRequest.rateRule: Next request begins at previous awaited close + 20 ms; public work consumes additional time. Log actual rate, public-write and close intervals and native commits; never infer overlap from pacing.
perRequest.productionBounds: Record and preserve deployed capture/review busy/deadline settings. Do not substitute a fixture deadline for production configuration.

same-owner.namespaces: Round robin personal, mist-prism, moss-chord, sand-orbit; every operation mutates the selected projection.

other-owner.namespaces: Same four namespace suffixes on the other owner in the SAME canonical database; excluded from readSet.

targets.other-project-control: Separate observational control only; never substitutes for same-projection writers.
targets.initialReviewPool: Before registration, seed four current Memories per target owner with public admit, record ids, exclude setup writes from samples. Review-only cells rotate this pool. Each supersede replaces the current pool id with its returned successor, so review never targets a stale id.
targets.bindings: All generated ids/revisions come from public results and are recorded in replay logs, never guessed. Same sequence, world/schema/target and repetition produce the same payloads and target slots.

memoryCapture.role: Explicit synthetic capture persistence, one new Memory with one 240-unit receipt.

memoryReview.role: Explicit synthetic decision review, retains previous record as historical; fresh successor and receipt. Resolve expectedRevision from public get immediately before the call.

cardCapture.role: Authored synthetic body plus submitted note; not yet a freshness target.

cardReview.role: Confirm the exact draft revision with applicability current; this commit begins eligibility.

operations.boundary: These are offline public persistence workloads, not timing substitutes for production core.capture extraction or reviewDecisionBasis inference. A production harness must separately bind its actual capture/review paths and record their unchanged deadlines. No provider invocation is authorized by this fixture.

contention.pairOrder: reader then no-reader on even repetitions; reverse on odd repetitions

freshness.targetNamespaceRule: Target index modulo four; apply same-owner or other-owner mapping. Only same-owner is a freshness gate; other-owner tokens must stay invisible.
freshness.betweenTargetCycles: Replay 47 background operations from captureReviewCycle; 20 ms after each awaited close. No catch-up queue. After target 119, continue background writes until 60000 ms after the final eligible commit.
freshness.eligibleCommitRule: Memory admit commit and Card confirm commit, as observed by independent native writer telemetry. Draft time is not Card eligibility. Record exact returned id/revision/bodyRevision and namespace.
freshness.probeRule: One unique ASCII lexical token per target; token appears only in that new eligible record and its own receipt/note. Fresh authorized findCandidates handles, both intents, no request repair. Exact id/revision/bodyRevision membership counts; fallback and unrelated matches never count.
freshness.censorRule: Never observed by the bounded ceiling => +infinity in nearest-rank p95, retained by type/intent/world/schema/mode. Incomplete commit populations are inconclusive; never silently delete failed targets. Writers run at least 30 seconds after final eligibility, including when all probes already succeeded.

availability.start: After first certified completed current AND history build, then include every scheduled normal index-dependent attempt including dirty/pump-gap intervals.
availability.classification: Mutually exclusive not-ready / timeout / other error / validated success. Exact evidence and probe calls do not dilute the normal-attempt denominator.

pump.budget: One serial supervised maintainer; alternate intents per quantum; at most 600 quanta, 153600 items and 30000 ms cumulative declared maxMs per renewal minute. Record actual cumulative work and durable checkpoints. No overlapping quantum; missed cadence slots are skipped. A stopped pump is not inferred live from durable status.
